items.reason: Verifier results produce timestamped documents under the set’s verify directory.
Reports accumulate without sequential overwrites; filing occurs once after the fallback walk.
The contract keeps VERDICT first, and the remaining reply becomes the report body.
Parsing preserves existing verdict behavior and retains malformed reply text.
Report writing applies to PASS, FIXABLE, and NEEDS-HUMAN.
PASS findings must explain what was checked and why each criterion is met.
Cache hits bypass the report-writing invocation path.
Invalidation deletes cached verdicts without deleting reports.
Verifier prompts receive no previous report; human-note forwarding remains unchanged.
Human Accept writes a report without invoking an agent.
Human reports include the rationale and overridden verdict.
Human reports identify their author as “human (Accept)”.
Human reports use the shared directory, filename, header, and latest-report machinery.
The gate preamble shows the latest report’s path and commit without its prose.
The paging action opens the report and returns to the gate menu.
The CLI detail view gains a Verify report pointer section.
Verify artifacts rank above Refine artifacts.
Agent prompt views gain no pointer; golden changes are limited to the Verifier response contract.
Missing Verify reports produce no Verify preamble, paging entry, detail section, or artifact.
Verification status and badge derivation remain independent of report age.
Status rows retain truncated findings but gain no adjacent report pointer; pointers appear only in detail sections.
Both passes share rendering, filing, scanning, and document-header parsing machinery.
Refine retains its existing storage format, header, prompt content, and rendering.
Refiner prompt golden files are unchanged.

scores.rationale: Clear shared machinery and useful regression tests; the status-row pointer requirement remains incomplete. Assessment was static.
